#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

##     - agent: "main"
##       message: "ROOT CAUSE PROVEN + MINIMAL FIX APPLIED (false-positive reconcile). ROOT CAUSE: viem decodes uint8 ABI outputs as JS 'number' (PROVEN via node repro with the app's own ABI file: statusOf -> 0 number, getAuction -> zeroed seller), but lib/auctionRegistration.js:42 guards with 'status !== 0n' (BigInt) — and '0 !== 0n' is TRUE in JS (different types) -> for EVERY unregistered auction the reconcile branch fired, writing contract_auction_id/chain_id/contract_address WITHOUT any transaction (creation_tx_hash stayed NULL) and returning 'Auction was already registered on-chain' — while the real create path was DEAD CODE. This explains: nonce never left 0, balance never paid gas, contract statusOf()=None, bids reverting BZ:not_found, OwnerRegistrationBar hiding after the fake write, and the bug reproducing identically across v2 + V3 + both agent runs. Historical consistency: Bomb was registered OUTSIDE this helper (Phase #2 called it 'manually-created'); Shoes' trio stayed NULL because its publish-time attempt threw earlier (wallet not ready) before the read. FIX (minimal, at the source, documented return contract preserved): lib/bidzoneAuction.js readAuctionStatus() now returns 'status == null ? null : BigInt(status)' — normalizes viem's uint8 number to BigInt so the existing 'status !== 0n' guard behaves as designed (0 -> create path, 1/2 -> reconcile path). Node-verified decision table: 0->create, 1/2->reconcile, both number and BigInt inputs. Lint clean. NO other code touched (OwnerRegistrationBar/bid-guard left as-is — with the root fixed the fake write can no longer occur; hardening backlog for later: treat contract_auction_id-set + creation_tx_hash-NULL as pending). STATE: V3 corrupted trio REPAIRED again to NULL (owner-session PATCH, disclosed; auction LIVE, ends 02:05:26Z). Dev server hot-reloads the fix; testing agent must hard-reload the page to pick up the new bundle. STEP 2 RE-REQUEST: rerun T1 on V3 (register on-chain: expect REAL tx + sellera nonce 0->1 + receipt + Supabase trio WITH creation_tx_hash) then T2-T9 per the 'STEP 2 DETAILED FLOW v3 FINAL' brief; all rules unchanged."

##     - agent: "main"
##       message: "T7 ROOT CAUSE = REAL UI BUG FOUND + MINIMAL FIX APPLIED. ROOT CAUSE (testing agent found it): RefundPanel was rendered ONLY inside BidForm, and BidForm renders ONLY when auction.status === 'LIVE' — but a refund EXISTS exactly when the auction is OVER (you were outbid / auction ended). Net effect: losing bidders on ENDED/SETTLED auctions could NEVER withdraw via the UI (high-impact fund-lock). FIX (minimal, BiddingPanel.jsx): (1) top-level useWallet() now also destructures privyWallet + address (walletAddress); (2) RefundPanel now ALSO renders at the panel top level for !isLive && isAuthed && !isSeller — component self-guards (renders only when onchain ready + refundOf > 0). LIVE behavior unchanged (panel still inside BidForm there). Lint clean; hot-reload picks it up. ALSO RE-STATE GROUND TRUTH (the previous agents' RPC probes kept lying): V7 IS settled on-chain (statusOf=4), DUP-SETTLE PROVEN REJECTED via simulateContract revert 'BZ:already_settled', seller +0.0975 EXACT (0.455831->0.553331), treasury +0.0025 EXACT (0->0.0025), sellerc 0.10 escrow = winning purchase, sellerb refundOf = 0.05 QUEUED (withdrawal blocked by the UI bug above — now fixed).
